exercises.title: Brokerage with a minimum
exercises.brief: brokerage_cost(trade_value, rate_pct=0.03, minimum=20) — percentage of value, but never below the minimum.
hints: max() picks the larger of two values
exercises.solution:
def brokerage_cost(trade_value, rate_pct=0.03, minimum=20):
    return max(trade_value * rate_pct / 100, minimum)

exercises.title: Add a holding (tracker)
exercises.brief: add_holding(portfolio, ticker, qty, buy_price, current) inserts a nested dict entry.
exercises.starterCode:
def add_holding(portfolio, ticker, qty, buy_price, current):
    pass
hints: The value is itself a dict with three keys
exercises.solution:
def add_holding(portfolio, ticker, qty, buy_price, current):
    portfolio[ticker] = {'qty': qty, 'buy_price': buy_price, 'current': current}
